title: Distinguish missing files from other not-found errors in diff refresh
outcome: DiffPanel only reports a file deletion for an actual missing file and preserves an accurate error state when a session, project or route lookup fails.
acceptance: A diff-refresh regression makes the backend report session/project/route not-found while the file exists and verifies that the panel does not clear a clean file or label it deleted.

A true missing-file regression still reports deletion, and dirty buffers remain preserved with existing reconciliation safeguards; error classification follows a typed API distinction or an equally specific file-read contract.
